propositions: Per-ticket runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD despite matching .gitignore patterns, causing marker churn to surface as working-tree deletions and dirty git status
The dirty git status breaks the strict head check in tracker_head_sha and causes plan-review attestations to fail with store-read-failure
An idempotent ensure unit must untrack these markers via git rm --cached in batches and materialize a single commit, leaving worktree copies intact
The reader must self-heal missing .archived markers by re-materializing them when a ticket's compiled state is archived but the marker file is absent
Peers merging the untrack commit will have git automatically delete their worktree marker copies as tracked-unmodified files, and subsequent list operations re-create markers as needed
